name: Subscriptions
description: All your subscriptions in one place: what they cost per month and year, and when the next payment is.
prompt: A subscriptions tracker with quick buttons for Netflix, Spotify and others, price and billing cycle, the total per month, year and day, upcoming payments with warnings for the next days and a tip on what you'd save.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Todas tus suscripciones en un solo sitio: lo que cuestan al mes y al año, y cuándo es el próximo pago.
